question: Identify the L1_model associated with each model (specified by name and version) that occurs most frequently for each status ('strong' or 'soft'), along with the number of times it occurs. A model has a 'strong' status if, for any of its steps, the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models is less than the 'Stack' model's test score. It has a 'soft' status if the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models equals the 'Stack' model's test score. Count how many times each L1_model is associated with a 'strong' or 'soft' status across all models, and determine which L1_model has the highest occurrence for each status.
sql:
WITH step_comparison AS (
    SELECT name, version, step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score ELSE 0 END) as stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score ELSE 0 END) as max_non_stack
    FROM model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_status AS (
    SELECT name, version,
           MAX(CASE WHEN stack_score > max_non_stack THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_strong,
           MAX(CASE WHEN stack_score = max_non_stack THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_soft_candidate
    FROM step_comparison
    GROUP BY name, version
),
model_l1 AS (
    SELECT name, version, L1_model
    FROM model
    GROUP BY name, version, L1_model
),
model_with_status AS (
    SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.is_strong, ms.is_soft_candidate, m.L1_model
    FROM model_status ms
    JOIN model_l1 m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
),
status_l1_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN is_strong = 1 THEN 'strong' WHEN is_soft_candidate = 1 THEN 'soft' ELSE NULL END as status,
        L1_model,
        COUNT(*) as count
    FROM model_with_status
    WHERE is_strong = 1 OR is_soft_candidate = 1
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY count DESC) as rn
    FROM status_l1_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY status
